proof_body:
by
  intro R M _ _ _ _ _ h
  have hle : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥ :=
    (IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top).ge
  have hbot := Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ⊤ Module.Finite.fg_top h.ge hle
  exact (Submodule.subsingleton_iff R).mp (subsingleton_of_bot_eq_top hbot.symm)
target_source: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M], (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) • (⊤ : Submodule R M) = ⊤ → Subsingleton M
